$comment: Rules for the artifact GitHub Pages publishes. Read by scripts/verify-public-build.mjs. Every pin entry stays on ONE LINE with a label word beside its value: script/scan.sh refuses a bare 32-byte value whose line carries no label, so a JSON pretty-printer that split these objects would break the secret scan. Edit as text.

uploadPath.$comment: The directory is RESOLVED from the workflow, never hardcoded here. That is the whole point: if the workflow starts uploading a build output, this verifier follows it to the new directory instead of continuing to check a file nobody serves.

prohibitedExternal.why: an external script is a third-party dependency this repository never disclosed
a stylesheet or font link is the same, and web/README.md claims neither exists
a CSS import fetches from wherever it points
a named CDN host, however it is referenced

accepted: UNICA demonstrates a live, verified USDC settlement flow on Uniswap v4 Sepolia, with order-bound full-fill enforcement and an indexable receipt.
UNICA demonstrates a live, verified USDC settlement flow on Uniswap v4 Sepolia.

assets.$comment: Local references must be relative and must resolve inside the uploaded directory. An absolute path works on a custom domain and breaks under a project-pages subpath or an IPFS CID prefix, which is exactly the portability this artifact is supposed to have.
